description: This file implements the sampling and profiling logic for internal hashtable metrics in the Abseil library, including functions for enabling/disabling sampling, recording rehashes, and managing sampling state.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Holds profiling data for hashtable instances, including probe lengths, hash distributions, and timing information.

methods.name: HashtablezInfo::PrepareForSampling
methods.description: Initializes profiling data fields before sampling begins.

methods.name: SampleSlow
methods.description: Determines whether to sample profiling data based on current state and sampling rate.

methods.name: UnsampleSlow
methods.description: Unregisters a hashtable's profiling info from sampling.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records data related to a rehash event, including total probe length.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Records changes in storage size and capacity.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records details of an insertion, including hash and probe length.

methods.name: RecordEraseSlow
methods.description: Records an erase event, updating size and erase count.

methods.name: SetHashtablezConfigListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for configuration changes.

methods.name: IsHashtablezEnabled
methods.description: Checks if hashtable profiling is enabled.

methods.name: SetHashtablezSampleParameter
methods.description: Sets the sampling rate for profiling.

methods.name: GetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of samples to collect.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of samples to collect.
